Plot QC cutoff effects

plot_qc_cutoffs.Rd

Show how different QC cutoff values affect the proportion of spots and genes that would be removed.

Usage

plot_qc_cutoffs(
  spe,
  library_cutoff = NULL,
  gene_cutoff = NULL,
  n_points = 200,
  theme_name = "classic"
)

Arguments

spe

A SpatialExperiment object containing QC metrics generated by `add_qcs()`.

library_cutoff

Optional selected cutoff for log library size.

gene_cutoff

Optional selected cutoff for log mean gene expression.

n_points

Number of cutoff values used to construct each curve. Default is 200.

theme_name

Plot theme. One of `"classic"`, `"bw"`, `"minimal"`, or `"gray"`.

Value

A list containing cutoff data and plot.

Details

No filtering is performed by this function.
